# Evercraft AI Boardroom

Capability ID: ai-boardroom-decision-review-v1
Commercial state: discovery_only
Machine state: source_discovery_only
Public URL: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/mesh/ai-boardroom/
Preferred agent route: universal fallback
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- why do ChatGPT and Claude disagree about my business decision
- compare different AI model answers for a business strategy
- multiple AI assistants give conflicting recommendations
- I want different AI models to debate a strategy
- have AI advisers challenge each other's business assumptions
- ask ChatGPT Claude and Gemini to critique a proposal
- AI boardroom for a tough executive decision
- multi-model decision review with risk and operational perspectives
- AI council to pressure-test a startup or company decision
- compare AI disagreements and identify the evidence needed

## Problem

Two or three AI answers disagree about a business decision. Compare stated positions, assumptions and evidence gaps for free in a private browser tool; deeper scoped human review is available separately.

## Inputs

One business decision question and two or three user-pasted AI answers. Do not supply private credentials or regulated information.

## Outputs

Free local comparison map and downloadable text report, with explicit uncertainty about unverified facts. Paid scope may be confirmed separately with Evercraft.

## Pricing

Free text comparison $0. Separate human-scoped Boardroom Standard Review $250 and Financial Deep Dive $500; no instant $9 paid SKU.

## Invocation and authority

FREE TEXT-ONLY BROWSER PREVIEW. Source-only public discovery; no verified automatic multi-LLM conversation, paid order or fulfillment.

Browser preview makes no model API calls and stores no user answers on Evercraft servers. Paid review must have agreed scope and delivery before matching provider checkout.

Payment authority: none declared

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
